hypothesis: Retained per-frame generator-allocation supervision with a past-only cached encoder can learn ordered complete wake and confusable sequences without pooled command shortcuts or discarded auxiliary heads.
sampling: One independently sampled full six-class matched cell per each of four carriers; fixed resumable sampler seeds.
objective: Soft generator-allocation cross entropy: valid-frame mean per complete recording then mean across batch. No background loss, no pseudo-empty background transcript.
checkpoint_policy: Save latest every 250 steps and final at 5000; no checkpoint selection on validation. Final checkpoint only for subsequent diagnostic replay.
event_policy: Existing exact ordered unit event policy; confidence code 128, span 200 frames, refractory 200 frames. Fixed diagnostic only, no qualified threshold.
resources: RTX4090 required; CPU numerical threads1. Read existing PCM, no new waveform/features cache, disk reserve100GiB. Keep initial/latest/final checkpoints only.
acceptance: Training diagnostic only. No replacement of frozen v30. Trained full-wave float behavior, actual-state INT8 calibration/export, fresh development and sealed acceptance including FAR upper95<=0.5/h remain required.
stop_conditions: Nonfinite loss/gradient, unavailable CUDA, insufficient disk reserve, or failed source hashes: stop and retain failure. Do not silently retry with changed hyperparameters.
